summary: You take RELIGST 304A and 304B, RELIGST 391 and 379 (379 is also the Paper-in-Field), each letter graded where a letter grade is offered. Coursework with five department faculty, two courses outside your subfield, your 3.0 GPA, the qualifying exams, teaching and the teaching practicum, candidacy, the two languages, the defense and the dissertation are checked by hand.

TueBSII6.why: "This requirement is fulfilled by taking RELIGST 379." RELIGST 379 is already required by the Course requirement ("The following two seminars (391 and 379)"), so the same course satisfies both.
